# Measured results: invalid approaches and methodological failures

An experiment that fails a gate still provides useful negative evidence. Do not silently relabel such a run as a successful optimization.

| ID | Classification | Observed issue | Required remedy |
|---|---|---|---|
| M01 | Wrong time range | Initial CBO 6k test queried after the last sample; empty vectors made the query look fast ([41530696837](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41530696837)). | Assert nonempty expected timestamps, series and cardinality before timing. |
| M02 | Instrumentation pollution | Diagnostic 1.33m JOIN SQL included `sipHash64(id)` checksum, which consumed a large share of CPU ([41532393067](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41532393067)). | Check identity separately; use count-only or real PromQL for measured path. |
| M03 | Non-paired benchmarks | CBO dedicated-stage-column initial test used different order and cached states ([41533707123](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41533707123)). | Use warm A/B/B/A, same query text and physical parts; publish rejected drift. |
| M04 | Floating-point equality | Hash of exact JSON bits falsely failed numerically equal time-series aggregates ([41531500328](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41531500328)). | Strict labels/timestamps; numeric tolerance and NaN/Inf handling. |
| M05 | Memory accounting | Whole 14d JOIN/native query OOM around 4.66GiB server RSS although per-query log memory much smaller ([41587498126](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41587498126)). | Monitor process RSS, jemalloc, background allocations and query-level tracking separately. |
| M06 | Assumed index pruning | A minmax index appeared in EXPLAIN but retained all marks ([41587537130](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41587537130)). | Validate `granules_after`, `SelectedMarks`, rows and CPU. |
| M07 | v11 DDL incompatibility | `id_type` setting rejected by v11 with `INVALID_SETTING_VALUE` ([41589662769](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41589662769)). | Declare the matching `id` column type on TAGS/SAMPLES/TimeRanges via `INNER COLUMNS`; preserve generator/index. |
| M08 | Wrong physical intervention | `INSERT SETTINGS low_cardinality_max_dictionary_size` produced byte-identical Wide parts even before merge ([41591296942](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41591296942)). | Confirm writer settings source and actual data-file SHA before profiling. |
| M09 | Drift gate tripped | `stage` block-size 1024 A/B/B/A drift 28.47% ([41588920790](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41588920790)). | Reject that variant, repeat under stable load; other seven jobs passed. |
| M10 | CPU vs latency conflation | One thread used less CPU than four but >2x wall time for stage14d ([41588920790](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41588920790)). | Report CPU/core cost, wall latency, runqueue and p95 separately. |
| M11 | Diagnostic vs native | SQL JOIN can be rewritten by optimizer; real TimeSeries selector also populates label collector and sample ID sets. | Require final native `prometheusQueryRange` parity and performance to claim end-to-end gains. |
| M12 | Overlapping processor time | Sum of `processors_profile_log.elapsed_us` across parallel processors overstates wall time; `input_wait_elapsed_us` is not automatically lock time. | Match query ID and operator, measure per-thread intervals/off-CPU and separate physical wall time. |
| M13 | Default source/schema generalization | v11 default `LowCardinality(UUID)` harms high-churn 1.33m series, but long-lived/dense or mixed fixtures can behave differently ([41590057398](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41590057398)). | Benchmark actual distinct IDs per part, samples/ID, merge cadence, compression and realistic query mixes; do not delete LC globally without evidence. |
| M14 | Build confounder | Comparing O1 patched and O2 stock binaries falsely attributes compiler optimization differences to source changes. | Same source commit, same compiler and flags for baseline and candidate; inspect `BUILD_INFO`. |
| M15 | Attribution confounder | `trace_log` CPU sampling is statistical and can underrepresent short critical sections, while pthread futex sleeps include intentional idle queue waiting. | Require off-CPU samples or per-thread scheduling telemetry, owner-aware lock tracing and collector overhead control. |
| M16 | Event-loop work contamination | Variable client-side JSON serialization or checksum can dominate microbenchmarks. | Use `FORMAT Null` for physical CPU microprobes; keep native JSON for real query end-to-end checks. |

| M17 | Truncated cross-variant CPU attribution | CPU leaves query used `ORDER BY query_id,samples DESC LIMIT 240`, returning only baseline's leaf rows, not the raw UUID variant, despite both having complete category counts ([41590051439](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41590051439)). | Use `LIMIT N BY query_id` or independent per-query fetch. Fixed four CPU profiling scripts. Do not compare absent raw leaf rows from the old artifact. |
| M18 | Observer effect | Full `/proc/TID/status` + `wchan` sampling on 200+ server threads every 25 ms spent **81%** of some measured intervals in instrumentation ([41594014184](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41594014184)). | Reject attribution. Use v2 sparse sampling with per-TID schedstat, query_thread_log and self-overhead gate; report probe-on/off ABBA. |
| M19 | Lock scope conflation | `ContextTimeSeriesTagsCollector` is **per query context**. Eight independent client queries do not share that collector's `SharedMutex`. | Test 1/2/4/8 parallel threads within **one query**, and instrument collector lock acquisitions directly. Separate inter-query queue contention. |
| M20 | Futex idle bias | Most parked server threads may be background pools waiting in `futex_do_wait`; this is not evidence of mutex contention. | Match active OS TIDs to query_thread_log; time lock wait/hold using RAII source counters or eBPF lock probes, and distinguish voluntary sleep, runnable queue and mutex wait. |

| M21 | C++ instrumentation compilation | New `ProfileEvents` registered in `ProfileEvents.cpp` but were referenced in another translation unit without `extern const Event` declarations, so `CollectorLockHoldTimer` constructor failed template compilation ([41595505940](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41595505940)). | Add explicit event symbol declarations in collector C++ and rerun two instrumented O1 builds; keep failed binary and log as evidence. |
| M22 | Unstable baseline | Prehash C++ A/B/B/A `stage` 14d baseline drift 31.6%, and whole1d phase failed to expose all QueryFinish log rows after server restart ([41595298577](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41595298577)). | Reject incomplete or high-drift cases. Keep 4/4 native output checks. Retry explicit `SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS` and inspect query_log lifecycle before timing. |
| M23 | Query-specific improvement | Prehash outside exclusive collector lock improved `project`14d 11.6% (2224→1993ms), but regressed `branch` regex14d ~3.1% (2205→2273ms), both same source O1 and control drift under 25% ([41595298577](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41595298577)). | Do not promote this C++ change unconditionally. Require exact lock wait/hold measurement and a mixed workload gate. |
| M24 | Failed off-CPU observation | Lighter `/proc` sampler at 100ms still consumed 28–40% of sampled stage wave and triggered process RSS limit in concurrent project queries ([41594810932](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41594810932)). | Stop treating `/proc` polling as a low-overhead profiler. Prefer `ProfileEvents.OSCPUWaitMicroseconds`, built-in pool/context/parts lock counters, `query_thread_log`, and low-overhead targeted C++ lock probes. |
| M25 | GitHub Actions merge collisions | Shared branch may receive simultaneous pushes from multiple agents. A `cancel-in-progress: false` workflow with a branch-only concurrency group may still replace a pending run. | Use run-unique `github.run_id` groups. Audit actual active push workflows ([41596003933](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41596003933): 292 inventoried, 40 active on shared, no detected danger). Prefer fresh-file commits and blob-SHA optimistic updates; never reset. |

| M26 | Symlink mutated as file | Root `AGENTS.md` is a `120000` symlink to `.claude/CLAUDE.md`. Updating it through GitHub Contents API wrote 19 KB into the **symlink target string**, causing checkout `unable to create symlink AGENTS.md: File name too long` for both pipeline runs in [41597417015](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41597417015). | Restored literal 17-byte symlink target in commit `6d9143853b2c49c6bd7522b77f998e4418b5c695`. Updated the real `.claude/CLAUDE.md` file in `b1e1fad76a623e3859a73e5472161030ac09c902`. Never edit the symlink path via Contents API again. Check `git ls-files -s AGENTS.md` (mode 120000) and `readlink AGENTS.md` before CI. |
| M27 | Prehash wait-versus-hold distinction | Precise per-query `TimeSeriesTagsCollector` counters in [41596955580](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41596955580) show `project`14d at 4 threads: exclusive lock hold ~383→366 ms and wait ~4.57→3.36 ms, shared wait ~348→333 ms, but query wall 1851→1862 ms **regresses**. At 8 threads 1877→1923 ms regresses. | Do not promote prehash. Its causal effect on lock hold is smaller than total query cost and may add allocations outside the lock. Avoid extrapolating summed lock wait from worker threads as wall latency. Stage and whole runs had QueryFinish races; all logged errors preserved. |
| M28 | Asynchronous QueryFinish flush | The direct lock A/B/B/A restart workflow sometimes observed 5/6 `QueryFinish` entries even though all HTTP responses returned ([41596955580](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41596955580)). | Retry `SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS` with bounded 0.35–1.7s backoff; fail only if still missing. Fixes in `bench_tagcollector_lock_profile.py`, `bench_collector_prehash_cpp.py` and pipeline DAG comparator. |
| M29 | Native pipeline graph checkout blocked | First native processor-DAG workflow [41597417015](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41597417015) failed **before any SQL** because of M26; no CPU conclusion is available from that run. Source inspection then found duplicate `FORMAT JSONEachRow` in the DAG query construction. | Restored symlink, removed duplicate format, added synthetic cycle/parent/longest-chain graph tests. New CI run [41601027396](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41601027396). Treat structural DAG longest-sum work as approximation, NOT elapsed wall critical path. |

| M30 | Raw-ID TimeRanges selectivity crossover | In stock O1 after fixing v11 ID type, [#41601352971](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41601352971) **stage** at 1d becomes 13% slower if `store_time_ranges=0`, but at 3/7/14d becomes ~7/7/4% faster. Four stable A/B/B/A windows. **Whole metric** at 3d becomes 57% slower without ranges (2041→3205ms), 7d hits 4.66GiB total RSS OOM. Whole1d control drift 45.7% is **invalid**. | Never remove TimeRanges globally. Any adaptive skip must be semantics-preserving and memory-safe for broad selectors; require bound on query memory, per-workload cost estimate, fresh-proc RSS and 1/3/7/14d native parity. Do not use high-drift 1d whole figure. |
| M31 | Unsafe LC fast-path prototype | Source audit of the staged `apply_lc_fresh_dictionary_cpp.py` shows that fresh dictionary adoption bypasses `ColumnLowCardinality::insertRangeFromDictionaryEncodedColumn` and its `checkIndexesAreLimited` validation; the shared-index fast path copies index values without the stock bounds check. See [audit](../ts-lab-cpu/LC_DECODER_FASTPATH_SAFETY_AUDIT_20261103.md). This is a source-level defect, not a measured crash. | Block promotion until stock-equivalent index bounds/type/length guards and malformed-dictionary tests pass; require exact native PromQL parity and same-source O1 A/B/B/A. Never treat compile success as a correctness gate. |

| M32 | project14d eight-client memory ceiling | Stock-O1 full native [#41605951284](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41605951284): at 1 and 4 concurrent clients RAW UUID improves A/B/B/A p50/CPU with full output parity; at 8 clients the old-server continuation fails **MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED** at 4.47 GiB total RSS while executing AggregatingTransform. The stock process had already retained ~4.48 GB peak during 4-client phases. Overall project job fails, though stage and whole jobs pass. | Do NOT extrapolate valid 1/4-client speedups to 8-client survival or credit raw UUID with per-variant RSS savings in a long-lived same-process A/B/B/A. Preserve full artifact. Test same binary and immutable dataset at 8 clients using a **fresh process per phase**, compare startup RSS, query peak vs server RSS; CI [#41607617562](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41607617562). |

| M33 | Project8 fresh-server OOM, not just cross-load retention | Four fresh ClickHouse server processes in [#41607617562](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41607617562), exact stock O1 source/fixture and unchanged 4.47GiB cap: LC, RAW, RAW, LC. Every phase passes two 8-client warmup bursts and **fails on the next burst** with Code 241 at ~4.47-4.49GiB RSS. [Raw evidence and detailed analysis](../ts-lab-cpu/NATIVE_FRESH8_MEMORY_FAILURE_20261103.md). | Distinguish within-phase allocator retention from peak active query allocations; total-RSS OOM site `AggregatingTransform` does not assign root-cause blame. No valid 8-client latency/throughput A/B/B/A. Test query max_threads=1 under fixed clients and production allocator independently. |

| M34 | Reducing project8 query threads to 1 does not make 8-client workload safe | Fresh-process source-pinned [#41609140400](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/actions/runs/41609140400) with 8 project14d clients and `max_threads=1`: LC phase0 completes all 10 bursts with peak RSS4.01GiB, RAW phase1 fails after 8 bursts, RAW phase2 fails after 1, LC phase3 fails after 3. ## Open source-level gotchas

1. **High-cardinality dictionary decode:** source `SerializationLowCardinality.cpp` can call `ColumnLowCardinality::insertRangeFromDictionaryEncodedColumn` followed by `ColumnUnique::uniqueInsertRangeFrom` and `ReverseIndex::buildIndex`; a lab shortcut requires malformed/duplicate/nullable/continuous-read safety tests.
2. **Writer settings:** `MergedBlockOutputStream` creates writer settings from `data_part->storage.getContext()->getSettingsRef()`, not necessarily the current `INSERT` query context; `Compact` writer hardcodes `low_cardinality_max_dictionary_size=0`.
3. **Statistics:** `UniqV2` on a `LowCardinality` dictionary may count the unused default key. A staged source patch addresses this; prove NDV correctness, update cost, and optimizer impact before stacking.
4. **Index selection:** time-sorted projections on AggregatingMergeTree require incremental update/merge parity; `force_optimize_projection` can select a plan that a cost mode correctly rejects. TimeRanges metadata is not unconditionally removable.
5. **Lock tracing:** a sampled `futex_wait` without owner/call stack is only a possible lock or condition-variable wait, not proof of a contended mutex.
6. **Concurrency:** group name based solely on branch may serialize jobs or evict pending runs even with `cancel-in-progress: false`; use workflow-specific run ID.

## Rules for corrections

Append new findings with actual CI URL, pinned binary and fixture SHA, error string, invalid assumptions and a reproducible fix. When retracting a previous claim, preserve it and add a dated correction; never rewrite negative evidence as success.
